svg.title: Sentiment model development
svg.desc: Labels are split into train/dev and a frozen random test split. FinBERT is fine-tuned on sentence and aspect pairs. Training length was chosen on dev, the aspect input on cross-validation, then one change at a time was cross-validated against a baseline and chosen by a rule fixed in advance. Three seeds were trained and scored once on test, errors analysed, a neutral margin chosen on dev, and the choice re-checked on two more seeds. Scoring the corpus with the model waits for the team.
